_comment: English locale for Hangman. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim. Keep neutral tokens untranslated: the '[L]' / '[LIGHT]' bracket formats, the single-letter guess {letter}, the column headers (C00, C01, ...) and '_' blanks inside {board}.

_slots.{board}: Neutral rendered board (C00/C01 column headers, revealed letters, '_' blanks); do not translate
_slots.{letter}: The guessed letter or full word (kept as typed)
_slots.{pct}: Percentage of characters guessed correctly, formatted to 2 decimals

prompt.intro:
You are playing Hangman. The objective of the game is to guess the word by providing one letter guesses or the entire word.
Each column is numbered. The cells that need to be populated with letters are represented by '_'.

There are two ways you can answer. You can provide one letter guesses in the format of '[L]', or you can guess the entire word in the format of '[LIGHT]'.
If the given letter is in the word, it will be revealed in the grid.
If the given word is correct, you win.
As you play, the history of your choices will be appended below. Use the information to figure out the word and win.
You have 6 incorrect tries before the game ends.

invalid.wrong_format: Invalid move format. You did not respond with a valid 'letter' or 'word'.
invalid.already_guessed: You guessed the letter '{letter}' which has already been guessed.

message.wrong_word: Your guess of '{letter}' is not the target word.
message.letter_in: Your guess of {letter} is in the word
message.letter_not_in: Your guess of {letter} is not in the word. You have {tries_left} lives left.

outcome.win_word: Congratulations! You completed the Hangman puzzle.
outcome.win_board: Congratulations! You have completed the Hangman puzzle.
outcome.out_of_tries: You are out of tries. You guessed {pct} percentage of the characters correctly. The target word was : {target_word}
